display.title: Episode 411: The Storyteller, Chapter 5 (Yahrzeit of Rabbi Moshe Sofer, Chazak Bereishis)
display.summary_short: The yahrzeit of Rabbi Moshe Sofer of Pshevorsk, the Hakochainik march, Shema with a first-grade class, chapter 5 of The Storyteller, a Chanukah art letter, and why we call out Chazak.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on 12 Teves 5750. Uncle Yossi marks the yahrzeit of Rabbi Moshe Sofer of Pshevorsk, author of Ohr Pnei Moshe, whom Rabbi Zusha of Anipoli saw learning with a face like an angel while sparks flew from the letters he wrote; Uncle Yossi mentions his own family descends from him. After the Hakochainik march and a recap, a first-grade class from a Boro Park girls' school says the Shema. In chapter 5 of The Storyteller, Rabbi Yehuda stays at the merchant's mansion until after Shabbos but still cannot remember any story. The merchant says they must wait for 'the right time' and sends him home by coach in tears, but the coach suddenly stops and Rabbi Yehuda runs back: he has remembered one story. The mailbox shows a girl's Chanukah string of drawings and her first Chumash words, and Uncle Yossi notes the show is now 411 weeks old. He then explains why everyone calls out 'Chazak, Chazak, V'nis'chazek' this Shabbos as Bereishis is completed with Parshas Vayechi, followed by candle time and the sponsor.
display.lesson: Be patient and never give up; Hashem's help comes at the right time.
